Ngoc Hien Treasure sits on the northern end of Phu Quoc and the ratings are not an accident. Families keep coming back. Kids don't want to leave. Adults are surprised they had fun too.

If your Phu Quoc trip is all beaches and bars, this is the wildcard that makes it a proper holiday.
